def reseed_mirror_from_development(
    repo: Path,
    *,
    development: str,
    mirror: str,
    job_id: str,
    owner: str,
    remote: str = REMOTE,
    owner_pid: int | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Converge Preview Mirror hacia el árbol exacto de Desarrollo.

    Desarrollo permanece inmutable. El commit de convergencia utiliza el
    árbol exacto de development y conserva el mirror anterior como segundo
    padre, por lo que la actualización remota del mirror es fast-forward.
    """

    token = acquire_writer_lock(
        repo,
        job_id=job_id,
        owner=owner,
        owner_pid=owner_pid,
    )

    try:
        index_lock_recovery = recover_orphan_index_lock(repo)

        dirty = _status_counts(repo)
        if dirty["worktree_dirty"]:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "GIT_WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN",
                {
                    "reason":
                        "MIRROR_RESEED_REQUIRES_CLEAN_SHARED_WORKTREE",
                    **dirty,
                },
            )

        _run(repo, "fetch", remote, DEV_BRANCH)
        _run(repo, "fetch", remote, MIRROR_BRANCH)

        development_now = _run(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            f"{remote}/{DEV_BRANCH}",
        ).stdout.strip()

        mirror_now = _run(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            f"{remote}/{MIRROR_BRANCH}",
        ).stdout.strip()

        if development_now != development or mirror_now != mirror:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "REMOTE_MOVED_RETRY_REQUIRED",
                {
                    "development_expected": development,
                    "development_now": development_now,
                    "mirror_expected": mirror,
                    "mirror_now": mirror_now,
                },
            )

        if development == mirror:
            return {
                "status": "MIRROR_ALREADY_CONVERGED",
                "development": development,
                "mirror_before": mirror,
                "mirror_after": mirror,
                "development_moved": False,
                "history_preserved": True,
                "index_lock_recovery": index_lock_recovery,
            }

        development_tree = _run(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            f"{development}^{{tree}}",
        ).stdout.strip()

        commit_env = dict(os.environ)
        commit_env.update(
            {
                "GIT_AUTHOR_NAME": "EDARSAHUB Worker",
                "GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL": "worker@edarsahub.local",
                "GIT_COMMITTER_NAME": "EDARSAHUB Worker",
                "GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL": "worker@edarsahub.local",
            }
        )

        reseed_commit = _run(
            repo,
            "commit-tree",
            development_tree,
            "-p",
            development,
            "-p",
            mirror,
            "-m",
            "chore(mirror): canonical reseed from development",
            env=commit_env,
        ).stdout.strip()

        parents = _run(
            repo,
            "show",
            "-s",
            "--format=%P",
            reseed_commit,
        ).stdout.strip().split()

        if parents != [development, mirror]:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "MIRROR_RESEED_PARENT_CONTRACT_FAILED",
                {
                    "expected": [development, mirror],
                    "actual": parents,
                },
            )

        candidate_tree = _run(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            f"{reseed_commit}^{{tree}}",
        ).stdout.strip()

        if candidate_tree != development_tree:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "MIRROR_RESEED_TREE_MISMATCH",
                {
                    "development_tree": development_tree,
                    "candidate_tree": candidate_tree,
                },
            )

        _run(repo, "fetch", remote, DEV_BRANCH)
        _run(repo, "fetch", remote, MIRROR_BRANCH)

        development_pre_push = _run(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            f"{remote}/{DEV_BRANCH}",
        ).stdout.strip()

        mirror_pre_push = _run(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            f"{remote}/{MIRROR_BRANCH}",
        ).stdout.strip()

        if (
            development_pre_push != development
            or mirror_pre_push != mirror
        ):
            raise GitGuardError(
                "REMOTE_MOVED_RETRY_REQUIRED",
                {
                    "reason":
                        "REF_MOVED_BEFORE_MIRROR_RESEED_PUBLICATION",
                    "development_expected": development,
                    "development_now": development_pre_push,
                    "mirror_expected": mirror,
                    "mirror_now": mirror_pre_push,
                },
            )

        push = authorized_push(
            repo,
            args=[
                "push",
                remote,
                f"{reseed_commit}:refs/heads/{MIRROR_BRANCH}",
            ],
            job_id=job_id,
            owner=owner,
        )

        if push.returncode != 0:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "GIT_PUSH_FAILED",
                {
                    "reason":
                        "MIRROR_RESEED_FAST_FORWARD_PUBLICATION_FAILED",
                    "output":
                        (push.stdout or "")[-2000:],
                },
            )

        _run(repo, "fetch", remote, DEV_BRANCH)
        _run(repo, "fetch", remote, MIRROR_BRANCH)

        final_development = _run(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            f"{remote}/{DEV_BRANCH}",
        ).stdout.strip()

        final_mirror = _run(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            f"{remote}/{MIRROR_BRANCH}",
        ).stdout.strip()

        final_tree = _run(
            repo,
            "rev-parse",
            f"{final_mirror}^{{tree}}",
        ).stdout.strip()

        if final_development != development:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "MIRROR_RESEED_DEVELOPMENT_MOVED",
                {
                    "expected": development,
                    "actual": final_development,
                },
            )

        if final_mirror != reseed_commit:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "MIRROR_RESEED_REMOTE_MISMATCH",
                {
                    "expected": reseed_commit,
                    "actual": final_mirror,
                },
            )

        if final_tree != development_tree:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "MIRROR_RESEED_TREE_MISMATCH",
                {
                    "development_tree": development_tree,
                    "mirror_tree": final_tree,
                },
            )

        ancestor = _run(
            repo,
            "merge-base",
            "--is-ancestor",
            mirror,
            final_mirror,
            check=False,
        )

        if ancestor.returncode != 0:
            raise GitGuardError(
                "MIRROR_RESEED_HISTORY_NOT_PRESERVED",
                {
                    "mirror_before": mirror,
                    "mirror_after": final_mirror,
                },
            )

        return {
            "status": "CERTIFIED_MIRROR_RESEEDED",
            "development": development,
            "development_after": final_development,
            "development_moved": False,
            "mirror_before": mirror,
            "mirror_after": final_mirror,
            "history_preserved": True,
            "reseed_commit": reseed_commit,
            "development_tree": development_tree,
            "mirror_tree_after": final_tree,
            "tree_matches_development": True,
            "development_ref_updated": False,
            "index_lock_recovery": index_lock_recovery,
        }

    finally:
        release_writer_lock(repo, token)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

import pytest

from tools.mirror_sync import git_divergence_guard as guard


def git(repo: Path, *args: str) -> str:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args],
        cwd=str(repo),
        text=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        check=True,
    )
    return proc.stdout.strip()


def init_repo(tmp_path: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    remote = tmp_path / "remote.git"
    repo = tmp_path / "repo"

    subprocess.run(
        ["git", "init", "--bare", str(remote)],
        check=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        text=True,
    )

    subprocess.run(
        ["git", "init", str(repo)],
        check=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        text=True,
    )

    git(repo, "config", "user.name", "EDARSAHUB Worker")
    git(repo, "config", "user.email", "worker@edarsahub.local")
    git(repo, "remote", "add", "origin", str(remote))

    return remote, repo


def commit_file(
    repo: Path,
    name: str,
    content: str,
    message: str,
) -> str:
    target = repo / name
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

    git(repo, "add", "--", name)
    git(repo, "commit", "-m", message)

    return git(repo, "rev-parse", "HEAD")


def test_reseed_contract_exists():
    assert callable(
        guard.reseed_mirror_from_development
    )


def test_reseed_source_has_expected_safety_contract():
    source = (
        Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
        / "tools"
        / "mirror_sync"
        / "git_divergence_guard.py"
    ).read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    block = source.split(
        "def reseed_mirror_from_development(",
        1,
    )[1].split(
        "\ndef main() -> int:",
        1,
    )[0]

    assert '"commit-tree"' in block
    assert "authorized_push(" in block

    assert '"reset"' not in block
    assert '"rebase"' not in block

    assert (
        'f"{reseed_commit}:refs/heads/{MIRROR_BRANCH}"'
        in block
    )

    assert (
        'f"{reseed_commit}:refs/heads/{DEV_BRANCH}"'
        not in block
    )


def test_reseed_preserves_mirror_history_and_dev_tree(
    tmp_path,
    monkeypatch,
):
    _remote, repo = init_repo(tmp_path)

    base = commit_file(
        repo,
        "shared.txt",
        "base\n",
        "base",
    )

    git(repo, "branch", "-M", guard.DEV_BRANCH)

    git(
        repo,
        "push",
        "origin",
        f"{base}:refs/heads/{guard.DEV_BRANCH}",
    )

    git(repo, "checkout", "-b", "mirror-local", base)

    mirror = commit_file(
        repo,
        "preview-only.txt",
        "preview\n",
        "preview",
    )

    git(
        repo,
        "push",
        "origin",
        f"{mirror}:refs/heads/{guard.MIRROR_BRANCH}",
    )

    git(repo, "checkout", guard.DEV_BRANCH)

    development = commit_file(
        repo,
        "development-only.txt",
        "development\n",
        "development",
    )

    git(
        repo,
        "push",
        "origin",
        f"{development}:refs/heads/{guard.DEV_BRANCH}",
    )

    git(repo, "fetch", "origin")

    result = guard.reseed_mirror_from_development(
        repo,
        development=development,
        mirror=mirror,
        job_id="TEST-MIRROR-RESEED",
        owner="pytest",
    )

    assert result["status"] == "CERTIFIED_MIRROR_RESEEDED"
    assert result["development_moved"] is False
    assert result["history_preserved"] is True
    assert result["tree_matches_development"] is True
    assert result["development_ref_updated"] is False

    git(repo, "fetch", "origin")

    remote_dev = git(
        repo,
        "rev-parse",
        f"origin/{guard.DEV_BRANCH}",
    )

    remote_mirror = git(
        repo,
        "rev-parse",
        f"origin/{guard.MIRROR_BRANCH}",
    )

    assert remote_dev == development
    assert remote_mirror == result["reseed_commit"]

    dev_tree = git(
        repo,
        "rev-parse",
        f"{remote_dev}^{{tree}}",
    )

    mirror_tree = git(
        repo,
        "rev-parse",
        f"{remote_mirror}^{{tree}}",
    )

    assert mirror_tree == dev_tree

    parents = git(
        repo,
        "show",
        "-s",
        "--format=%P",
        remote_mirror,
    ).split()

    assert parents == [development, mirror]

    subprocess.run(
        [
            "git",
            "merge-base",
            "--is-ancestor",
            mirror,
            remote_mirror,
        ],
        cwd=str(repo),
        check=True,
    )


def test_reseed_fails_closed_when_remote_moves(tmp_path):
    _remote, repo = init_repo(tmp_path)

    base = commit_file(
        repo,
        "base.txt",
        "base\n",
        "base",
    )

    git(repo, "branch", "-M", guard.DEV_BRANCH)

    git(
        repo,
        "push",
        "origin",
        f"{base}:refs/heads/{guard.DEV_BRANCH}",
    )

    git(
        repo,
        "push",
        "origin",
        f"{base}:refs/heads/{guard.MIRROR_BRANCH}",
    )

    with pytest.raises(
        guard.GitGuardError,
        match="REMOTE_MOVED_RETRY_REQUIRED",
    ):
        guard.reseed_mirror_from_development(
            repo,
            development="0" * 40,
            mirror=base,
            job_id="TEST-REMOTE-MOVED",
            owner="pytest",
        )

objective: Implementar exclusivamente la capacidad canónica y fail-closed para converger mirror/emergent-live hacia el árbol exacto de Edarsahub_Desarrollo cuando ambas ramas están divergidas. Desarrollo no debe moverse. El historial anterior del mirror debe conservarse como segundo padre del commit sintético. Este job implementa y prueba la capacidad; no ejecuta el reseed real.
